items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s Francine. For me to have two marriages like that – that’s a blessing.

ctx.x: Rock Falls, Illinois. Rock Falls, Illinois, is about 90 miles from Chicago. I was 13 1/2 pounds when I was born. Like Francine says, that’s where I got the double bass drums. 13 1/2 pounds. That’s a big baby. That’s a giant of a baby. My dad was big. My mother was small. So I got the smallness from my mom, and the bigness in my hands and feet from my dad.
Can you tell us about your childhood? Do you remember the address of the home where you were born or where you lived first, originally lived?
